text.p: - According to an opinion poll conducted by the Centre for Strategic Analysis and Prognosis, the much expected government reshuffle in Russia is aimed only at letting the steam of public discontent out and has no realistic programme to back it.
- If Russia does not reinforce its economic position in Tajikistan, it may lose influence in this Central Asian country.

- Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin may today announce the first stage of the serious government shake-up masterminded by Anatoly Chubais, the chief of the presidential administration. A number of deputy ministers may be sacked,
- Rivals of the Russian military space forces that launched the first satellite from a new cosmodrome in Yakutia are unhappy about its dominance in the profitble commercial launches.
- On the eve of the new redivision of powers in Russia, President Boris Yeltsin is acting in his own interests.
- St Petersburg has a fair chance of holding the Olympic Games of 2004, with Russia's president and prime minister backing the idea.
- Russia is being humiliated in its dispute with Ukraine over the Crimean peninsula.
- Josef Stalin's great grandson is feeling lonely in Moscow.
